user_outcome: Agents keep honest robust short-history fallback behavior instead of receiving an unvalidated pretrained path that is unstable across domains; humans keep visible support and transfer provenance without a false accuracy upgrade.

candidate.name: toto2_4m
candidate.registry_provenance: 84 held-out synthetic cases; no TemporalBench cases

governed_smoke.note: The larger governed arm was not run after supply failed, as preregistered.

candidate_family_disposition.classical_univariate: Retain current governed selection and robust fallback. Synthetic gains were family-uneven and naturalistic fold-starved channels do not justify a new default.
candidate_family_disposition.pretrained_univariate: Toto2-4M, the only candidate with an independent versioned transfer registry, failed the naturalistic matched gate. Other installed-capable TSFMs have no equivalent independent registry and are no-build for default admission until one exists.
candidate_family_disposition.cross_series_or_covariate: Deferred to P4, where identical-fold multivariate evidence is required rather than treating pooling as an univariate short-history fix.
candidate_family_disposition.context_analog: Deferred to P3 and remains scenario/evidence work; it is not admitted as an unsourced numeric short-history estimator.

promoted_general_fixes: explicit sequential local forecast worker cap
